text: Ben: heads up — PR #855 updated the SDK snippets (py) and Vercel preview linkcheck is failing on anchor refs: https://vercel.app/docs-redwood/pr-855 Maria: I saw the failure in CI: linkcheck reports 5 broken anchors, most point to new section ids that mkdocs-slugified differently than our previous anchors Sam: is this the mkdocs slug plugin change? I remember we switched slugify style in mkdocs.yml earlier this month Priya: yep, `slugify: gitlab` vs `default` changes how headings become anchors. The local `mkdocs serve` used by many devs might be running a different mkdocs version than CI so you don't see the break locally Ben: how should we fix — revert slugify or update links? Want minimal churn for backporting to older branches Maria: quick approach: update PR to use explicit anchors for the new headings, e.g. `` above the heading so slugifier doesn't matter. It's ugly but stable across versions Sam: alternative is to pin mkdocs and mkdocs-material in docs-ci to the same minor versions devs run. That avoids needing anchors everywhere but requires a CI change and release note Priya: for the immediate merge window, do the explicit anchors and add a follow-up ticket to pin dependencies. Also update the CONTRIBUTING.md with the `pipx run mkdocs --version` to check local parity Ben: ok I'll push a tiny commit adding explicit anchors and a note in the PR description. Can someone run the Vercel preview smoke check after update? docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed for PR #855 — details: https://ci.internal/reports/855 VercelBot: Preview updated for PR #855 — https://deploy-preview-855--docs-redwood.vercel.app (linkcheck still failing) Maria: after Ben's commit, I re-triggered the preview. VercelBot shows linkcheck passed for internal anchors, two external URL redirects still flaky (third-party docs changed their permalink) Sam: for external redirects, add the canonical redirect mapping in `mkdocs.yml` under `plugins: redirect` so linkcheck points to final URL; we did that in a previous PR for the cloud-provider page Priya: note for reviewers: please validate the rendered SDK code block for Python — I saw one triple-backtick fence with `python` but the snippet used `from redwood import Client` which should be `from redwood_inference import Client` (small package rename). That will break copy-paste examples Ben: good catch. I'll fix the import in the snippet and add a unit test that loads the docs page HTML and checks for `from redwood_inference` text so CI will catch regressions Maria: approving the content changes once snippets and anchors are fixed. Scheduling merge during docs merge window at 16:00 PT to avoid preview collisions Sam: local smoke test I run before pushing: `pipx run mkdocs build && sed -n '1,200p' site/sdk/overview/index.html | grep -E "from redwood|sdk-usage-py"` — ensures anchor and import appear in built HTML Priya: FYI when copying assets from `static/` to `site/` the Vercel builder strips trailing slashes differently; watch for links like `/static/img/logo.png` vs `/img/logo.png` — prefer relative paths in docs Ben: pushed fixes: explicit anchors, corrected import, redirect mapping. PR description updated with testing steps and merge window note: merge at 16:00 PT docs-bot: docs-ci started for PR #855 — linkcheck and preview build queued VercelBot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview-855--docs-redwood.vercel.app — linkcheck PASS :white_check_mark: Maria: I verified the python snippet copy-pastes cleanly in a fresh virtualenv. Approving now :heavy_check_mark: Ben: thanks all — will merge at 16:00 PT and post a short changelog entry in docs/changelog.md about the slugify change and the follow-up dependency pin ticket Priya: leaving this thread open until merge completes
